name: Click Assist
description: Input buffer per game mode, timing reports, hitbox shrink, hitbox display with trail, and an experimental pathfinder with recording. CHEAT: do not use for leaderboard records.

notify.name: Notifications
notify.description: Show early/late click, death report, hitbox and pathfinder notifications.

frame-rate.name: Frame Rate
frame-rate.description: Frames per second used to convert frames to time (240 = physics steps).

hitbox-trail.name: Hitbox Trail
hitbox-trail.description: Draw a fading trail of the player hitbox.

trail-length.name: Trail Length
trail-length.description: How many frames the trail keeps.

hitbox-range.name: Hitbox Draw Range
hitbox-range.description: Only draw object hitboxes within this distance of the player (lower = faster).

hitbox-enabled.name: Hitbox Shrink (CHEAT)
hitbox-enabled.description: Shrinks hazard and player hitboxes so you survive slightly wrong timing.

shrink-blocks.name: Also Shrink Solid Blocks
shrink-blocks.description: Not recommended: the player can get stuck inside blocks.

pathfinder-enabled.name: Pathfinder (EXPERIMENTAL CHEAT)
pathfinder-enabled.description: Searches for inputs by itself using checkpoint look-ahead and records them. Heavy on weak devices.

pf-horizon.name: Pathfinder Look-ahead (updates)
pf-horizon.description: How far ahead each candidate is simulated. Higher = smarter but slower.

pf-interval.name: Pathfinder Interval (updates)
pf-interval.description: A new decision is made every N updates. Higher = faster but less precise.

replay-path.name: Replay Saved Path
replay-path.description: Play back the last path saved for this level. Turn off Pathfinder when using this.

cube-frames.name: Cube Buffer (frames)
cube-frames.description: A click is held for at least this many frames. 0 = off.

ship-frames.name: Ship Buffer (frames)
ship-frames.description: Not recommended: makes the ship rise longer. 0 = off.

ball-frames.name: Ball Buffer (frames)
ball-frames.description: A click is held for at least this many frames, and re-tapped on landing. 0 = off.

ufo-frames.name: UFO Buffer (frames)
ufo-frames.description: A click is held for at least this many frames. 0 = off.

wave-frames.name: Wave Buffer (frames)
wave-frames.description: Not recommended: makes the wave go up longer. 0 = off.

robot-frames.name: Robot Buffer (frames)
robot-frames.description: A click is held for at least this many frames. 0 = off.

spider-frames.name: Spider Buffer (frames)
spider-frames.description: A click is held for at least this many frames, and re-tapped on landing. 0 = off.

swing-frames.name: Swing Buffer (frames)
swing-frames.description: A click is held for at least this many frames. 0 = off.
